The flavour names are split from their descriptors and the order no longer matches (Blood Orange sits beside 'Cool & crisp'). The descriptors are set larger than the 'Mix a pack' line, which is squeezed into tiny wrapped text, and the flavour names nearly compete with the headline. B: the CTA has jumped to the top-left, ahead of the headline and logo, which breaks reading order, and the logo is jammed toward the right edge. The two leftover cans are tiny orphans in the bottom-left corner, and the text block is crammed together with the same flavour/descriptor mismatch. Still, B's centred hero can and headline make a clearer focal hierarchy than A's lopsided layout.
